if: >-
      github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
      github.repository == 'Ullmann27/lumo-godot' &&
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'chatgpt/lumo-nextgen-20261113' &&
      (github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'integration/lumo-connections-20261113' ||
      github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'integration/lumo-safe-area-20261113') &&
      needs.learning-preview.result == 'success' &&
      needs.gameplay.result == 'success' &&
      needs.new-worlds.result == 'success' &&
      needs.touch-density.result == 'success' &&
      needs.bundle-evidence.result == 'success'
